title: The Words — Sc054: Darwin's hallway solo (one symbol, borrowed photo plate)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: A solo corridor scene with one actor, one plate and one master symbol: Darwin enters from behind a hallway pillar (clipped by a mask layer, not redrawn), then wanders the photographic corridor inside a single nested symbol -- 'DRW_marche + lente' ('walk + slow') -- cycling through an emotion tour: smug singing with clasped hands, an eyes-closed belted note, worry, pleading, annoyed explaining. Nobody else exists in the shot. The ending is a scale punch on the same plate: small distant figure (frame 172) to looming worried near-camera (frame 201) to a frame-filling bliss close-up (frame 229) -- a 'zoom' achieved purely by scaling the placement, no camera and no new background. Even the plate is borrowed: it is a crop of a GB110 'The Fight' background.
notes: The background is not this episode's art: it is GB110FIGHT_SC143_crop.jpg -- a crop of a scene background from GB110 'The Fight', reused as the hallway plate for a GB214 scene.
The whole performance is one master symbol on one layer: 'DRW_marche + lente' (French: 'walk + slow', 775 kf) placed with 21 keyframes on the 'dwn' layer; Darwin's headcomp alone holds 1083 kf.

A mask layer ('Layer 5') plus a 'perspective' guide layer ship in the file: at ~frame 29 Darwin is clipped by the hallway pillar he passes behind -- occlusion is solved with the mask, not by redrawing him.

The SWF is 5.3 MB of which almost everything is the embedded layout video: stripping the 230 video tags (the pipeline's swf_strip_video.py) leaves a 283 KB file; the scene was rendered from that novid copy, frames identical except the guide video.

backgrounds.type: bitmap plate (layout/BG art as bitmap; photographic only if render-verified)

tags.evidence: scene carries a 'layout mov' reference-video layer
contact sheet: the school hallway background is a real photographic corridor (tile pillars, lockers, ceiling lights, polished floor), rendered pale/washed, with a flat vector puppet over it

Darwin is the only character in all 229 frames; by frames 201-229 the same placement scales him up until he fills the right half of the frame, eyes closed in a bliss close-up, performance carried by GB200_DRW_HEADCOMP (1083 kf)
